run_dump_w2v2_features: run the CLI to dump wav2vec 2.0 features from audio files listed in a TSV shard
create_Wav2Vec2FeatureReader: create a Wav2Vec2FeatureReader instance from a fairseq checkpoint path and model layer number
test_read_audio: test the read_audio method to load a WAV file and return a 1D numpy array

review_main: review the main function that orchestrates feature extraction across TSV shards using nshard and rank
